The Philosophy

Local only. Always.

Your notes live on your disk. Your diary is encrypted with your PIN. Oren never connects to the internet, never asks for an account, never sends your data anywhere. In 2026, that’s radical. We think it should be the default.

One app. Everything inside.

Most apps do one thing. Oren does everything — a full Markdown editor, an encrypted diary, a MonkeyType-style typing test, a drawing canvas, a snippet library, nine built-in games, a Pomodoro timer, and a dashboard that tracks your writing streak. All offline. All in one place.

Write without the noise.

Zen mode hides everything but your words. Split editor lets you reference one note while writing another. Wiki-style [[links]] connect your thoughts. Markdown preview renders as you type. The editor gets out of the way and lets you think.

A private space that’s actually private.

PIN-protected access. AES-128 encryption on every entry. Mood tracking. Tags. Search. Export. Your diary entries are encrypted on disk — not even Oren can read them without your PIN.

Get faster while you’re at it.

A full MonkeyType-style typing test lives inside Oren. Five modes — time, words, quote, custom, code. Real-time highlighting, personal best tracking, WPM charts. Take a break from writing by getting better at it.
